evals.prompt: Audit eval1_transfer.swift for iOS concurrency issues, main thread stalls, and actor bugs. Propose surgical fixes using modern Swift idioms.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging the main-thread synchronous file I/O in viewDidLoad and the actor reentrancy balance check bug in AccountManager, categorized by severity with surgical fixes.
expectations: Identifies actor reentrancy vulnerability in AccountManager.transfer
Identifies synchronous Data(contentsOf:) or JSON decoding blocking the main thread in viewDidLoad
Provides surgical code fixes for both issues

evals.prompt: Audit eval2_feed.swift. The table view experiences noticeable scrolling hitches and mini-hangs. Pinpoint the root causes and provide remediation.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying the repeated DateFormatter allocation in cellForRowAt and main thread image decompression, classifying them as scroll hitches with modern Swift solutions.
expectations: Identifies DateFormatter instantiation in cell configuration as a scroll hitch / allocation hazard
Identifies synchronous UIImage(data:) decompression on main thread
Suggests static/cached DateFormatter or modern Swift FormatStyle
Suggests offloading image decompression using preparingForDisplay() or background decoding

evals.prompt: Audit eval3_swift6_persistence.swift for Swift 6 strict concurrency issues, unsafe Sendable escapes, and Core Data thread violations.
evals.expected_output: Audit report flagging @unchecked Sendable concealing mutable state data race in TokenStore, and NSManagedObject crossing actor boundary in OrderProcessor with NSManagedObjectID remediation.
expectations: Identifies @unchecked Sendable on TokenStore concealing unsynchronized mutable dictionary access
Identifies passing NSManagedObject across actor boundary in OrderProcessor.processOrder
Recommends actor isolation or Swift 6 Mutex / OSAllocatedUnfairLock for TokenStore
Recommends passing NSManagedObjectID and fetching on isolated background context

evals.prompt: Audit eval4_task_leak.swift for Task lifecycle issues, retain cycles, and memory leaks with AsyncSequence.
evals.expected_output: Audit report identifying strong self capture in infinite NotificationCenter AsyncSequence loop preventing UIViewController deallocation, with weak self and view lifecycle cancellation fixes.
expectations: Identifies strong self capture in Task with infinite NotificationCenter AsyncSequence
Identifies retain cycle / memory leak preventing LiveEventViewController deallocation
Suggests [weak self] capture in Task closure
Recommends explicit cancellation of Task when view is dismissed or disappears
